title: Independence of Alice's special bit from the coarse variable
statement:
Fix a positive integer $n$ and take the hard distribution on samples conditioned on the event that Alice's set $X$ and Bob's set $Y$ are disjoint, and further conditioned on Bob's special bit $Y_T$ being false. Under this conditional distribution the mutual information between Alice's special bit $X_T$ and the coarse variable $(T,\, X_{<T},\, Y_{>T})$ is zero:
\[
I\bigl(X_T \,;\, (T,\, X_{<T},\, Y_{>T})\bigr) = 0,
\]
so that $X_T$ is independent of $(T,\, X_{<T},\, Y_{>T})$.
